name: @red-cup-engineering/crucible-561-group
description: crucible.561.group — a daily-seeded single-player puzzle where every move's energy cost is the measured obstruction (@lenticule-science/metrologic H1 rank / settling depth / regime) of that move, not a designer spreadsheet. Deterministic replay: seed + move log -> identical final state and cost, always.

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit --noCheck --allowImportingTsExtensions --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target esnext src/*.mts web/test/*.test.mts && for f in web/js/*.mjs web/server.mjs; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
